claim: Spawning tool is named `Agent`. It was renamed from `Task` in v2.1.63. Old `Task(...)` still works as an alias. SDK streams may show either name, so match both. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
`Agent(agent_type)` in `tools` restricts spawnable types, and applies only to an agent run as the main thread with `claude --agent`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
Depth 3 and 20 concurrent by default (`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents

Subagent files are Markdown with YAML frontmatter; the body is the system prompt. Only `name` and `description` are required. Others include `tools`, `disallowedTools`, `model` (`sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `fable`, a full id or `inherit`), `permissionMode`, `maxTurns`, `hooks`, `isolation`. Built-ins: `Explore`, `Plan`, `general-purpose`. Each starts with fresh context; only its final message returns. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents

Agent SDK: define subagents with the `agents` option on `query()` (`AgentDefinition`: `description` and `prompt` required). Include `Agent` in `allowedTools`. Subagent messages carry `parent_tool_use_id`. Without a `subagent_type`, `general-purpose` is used. Cap fan-out with the two env vars plus `maxBudgetUsd` / `max_budget_usd`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/subagents

A subagent spawned by the main agent runs in the background by default (result status `async_launched`). A completed subagent's result text includes `agentId`, usable with `resume`. `Explore` and `Plan` are one-shot and return no `agentId`. `bypassPermissions` is never applied to a subagent (v2.1.267+). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/subagents

Session resume: capture `session_id` from the result message, pass it as `resume`. `continue` picks the most recent session. `forkSession` / `fork_session` branches history under a new id. Sessions persist the conversation, not the filesystem, under `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/*.jsonl`. Forked agents' edits are real and shared. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/sessions
Enumerate sessions: `listSessions()` / `list_sessions()`. Read one transcript: `getSessionMessages()` / `get_session_messages()` (TS / Python). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/sessions

File checkpointing snapshots and reverts files the agent changed; its API: confirm in docs. `persistSession` is named for memory-only throwaway sessions; scope (exam material says TypeScript-only) and Python equivalent: confirm in docs. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/sessions

`AskUserQuestion` always goes through the `canUseTool` callback, is denied in `dontAsk` mode, and is removed when `--permission-prompts none` is used. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/permissions

Cost: `total_cost_usd` is a client-side estimate that includes subagents and, on resume, earlier spend. `modelUsage` includes subagents; `usage` counts only the main loop. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/cost-tracking

Stop reasons: `end_turn`, `max_tokens`, `stop_sequence`, `tool_use`, `pause_turn`, `refusal`, `model_context_window_exceeded`; refusal detail lives in `stop_details`. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons
`pause_turn`: server-tool loop hit its default 10-iteration limit. Same URL as above.
Output cap: 128K tokens synchronous on the current models; Batches can reach 300k with beta header `output-300k-2026-03-24`; each batched request needs `max_tokens` of at least 1. Same URL as above.

Models (all 1M context, 128K output): `claude-fable-5-1` ($10/$50 per MTok), `claude-opus-5-5` ($4/$20), `claude-sonnet-5-5` ($2/$10), `claude-haiku-5-5` (from $0.10/$0.50). https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview
Legacy but available: `claude-fable-5`, `claude-opus-5`, `claude-opus-4-8`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`. Same URL as above.

Effort: `output_config.effort` with `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. Default `high` on Fable 5.1 and Sonnet 5.5, `medium` on Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort
Deprecated: `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` retires 2026-11-30, replacement `claude-sonnet-5-5`. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations
Sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k` removed in API version `2026-10-21` (400 even at default). Same URL as above.
Notice period: at least 60 days for publicly released models. Cloud-managed platforms set their own dates. Same URL as above.

Caching: `cache_control` of `{type: ephemeral, ttl: 5m|1h}`; up to 4 explicit breakpoints; 20-block lookback; 1h write costs 2x base input. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching
Cache reads: Opus 5.5 $0.20 vs $4 base; Sonnet 5.5 $0.10 vs $2. Same URL as above.
Minimum cacheable prompt: 512 tokens on the 5.5 generation and Fable 5.1, 1,024 on Sonnet 5, 4,096 on Haiku 4.5. Shorter prompts skip caching silently. Same URL as above.
Cache counters: `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens`; `input_tokens` counts only tokens after the last breakpoint. Same URL as above.

Batches: `POST /v1/messages/batches`, `custom_id` 1-64 chars, up to 100,000 requests or 256 MB, expire after 24 hours, results kept 29 days at `results_url`, status `in_progress` then `ended`, counts in `request_counts`. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing
Token counting: `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens`, returns `input_tokens`, an estimate, free but rate limited. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting

Tool overhead: definitions and tool blocks count as input tokens, plus a per-model system overhead (286 tokens on Opus 5.5 with `auto` or `none`). https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview
Rate-limit headers, error status mapping, `Retry-After` handling, exact `tool_choice` forcing semantics: confirm in docs.

CLAUDE.md files concatenate from the tree above the working directory (root first); subdirectory files load on demand. Imports use `@path/to/import`, max four hops. `/init` bootstraps one. `claudeMdExcludes` skips files. `AGENTS.md` can be read in place of CLAUDE.md. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory
Scopes: `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `./CLAUDE.md` or `./.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `./CLAUDE.local.md`, managed `/etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md` (Linux/WSL). Same page.

`.claude/settings.local.json` outranks `.claude/settings.json` and `~/.claude/settings.json`; only `--settings` and managed settings outrank it. Since v2.1.211 it sits at the repository root in a git repo. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings

Permission modes: `default` (alias `manual`), `acceptEdits`, `plan`, `auto`, `dontAsk`, `bypassPermissions`. Set by `--permission-mode`, Shift+Tab (not `dontAsk`) or `permissions.defaultMode`. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes

Interactive default is `auto` on v2.1.283 and later. A `-p` run with no mode set starts in Manual on v2.1.302 and later, and denies calls that need approval. Project-level `auto` and `bypassPermissions` defaults are ignored. Same page.
`bypassPermissions`: deny and explicit ask rules still apply; allow rules have no effect. Org switch: `permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode`. Same page.
Plan mode: `--permission-mode plan`, `/plan`, `ExitPlanMode`. A PreToolUse hook allow does not approve edits there. Same page.

`--disallowedTools` / `--allowedTools` / `--tools`; settings keys `permissions.allow`, `permissions.deny`, `permissions.ask`. Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions

PreToolUse input fields: `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`. Exit code 2 blocks. `permissionDecision` values: `allow`, `deny`, `ask`, `defer`. `updatedInput` rewrites arguments. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

Skill frontmatter: `allowed-tools`, `disallowed-tools`, `disable-model-invocation`, `user-invocable`, `context` (fork), `agent`, `paths`, `argument-hint`. Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills

Print mode: `-p`, `--bare` (needs `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, `--no-session-persistence`, `--resume`, `--append-system-prompt`. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless

`--output-format` takes `text`, `json`, `stream-json` (needs `--verbose`). JSON carries `result`, `session_id`, `usage`, `total_cost_usd` with a per-model breakdown, and `permission_denials`. Same page.
`--json-schema` with `--output-format json` fills `structured_output`; absent if the run ends without valid output. Same page.

Context editing: server-side clearing, beta header `context-management-2025-06-27`, set through the top-level `context_management` parameter with an `edits` array (`client.beta.messages` in SDKs). https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-editing

Two strategies: `clear_tool_uses_20250919` (oldest tool results) and `clear_thinking_20251015` (earlier thinking blocks). Use `clear_at_least`, because clearing invalidates cached prefixes. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-editing

`clear_tool_uses_20250919` defaults: trigger 100,000 input tokens (or tool uses), keep the 3 most recent tool use and result pairs, `exclude_tools` none, `clear_tool_inputs` false. Cleared results become placeholder text. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-editing
The docs call server-side compaction the primary strategy for long conversations and context editing the fine-grained option. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-editing

Compaction replaces older turns with a summary. Two forms: on demand (put the returned compaction block first in `messages`; header `compact-2026-09-04`; top-level `compaction` parameter) and at a token threshold (the API compacts inside ordinary requests when input tokens reach your trigger). https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/compaction
Client-side compaction in the tool runner was removed in API version 2026-10-21. See the migration guide. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/compaction
Claude Code `/compact`, auto-compaction and any pre-compaction hook event: confirm in docs.

Memory tool: client-side, `{type: memory_20250818, name: memory}`. Claude issues `view`, `create`, `str_replace`, `insert`, `delete`, `rename` against `/memories`; your code runs them and returns `tool_result`. Reject paths outside `/memories`. You own storage, size and expiry. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/memory-tool
Usage reading: `modelUsage` on the SDK result includes subagent requests; `usage` counts the main loop only. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/cost-tracking

Sessions persist the conversation, not the filesystem. Resume with `resume`; branch with `forkSession` / `fork_session`. A subagent starts fresh and returns only its final message. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/sessions
No platform identifiers were retrieved for this skill's brief, so none are asserted here.
Model ids, snapshot pinning and deprecation dates: confirm in docs. The lineup checked for `claude-prompt-engineering` is the starting point.

Server-managed settings: Owners set Claude Code policy in claude.ai Organization settings, Claude Code, Managed settings. Clients fetch at startup and poll hourly. Needs a Teams or Enterprise plan, the Owner or Primary Owner role, and network access to api.anthropic.com. Managed settings sit at the top of the precedence stack. Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings
Managed MCP control through this route uses `allowedMcpServers` and `deniedMcpServers`. A `managed-mcp.json` file cannot be delivered this way. Same doc.
Endpoint-managed alternatives: MDM or OS policy, or a `managed-settings.json` file. `requiredMinimumVersion` and `/status` also appear in this doc.

Telemetry: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` to `1` to enable OpenTelemetry export. Exporter variables in a repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `settings.local.json` are ignored. Only user, managed or shell settings can enable or route telemetry. Prompt text is not logged unless `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1`. `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES` also exists. Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage

Exporters: `OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER` takes `otlp`, `prometheus`, `console` or `none`. `OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER` takes `otlp`, `console` or `none`. Choose a protocol with `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` (`grpc`, `http/json`, `http/protobuf`); there is no default. A generic `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` set in managed settings strips developer-set per-signal endpoints. Same doc.
Metrics include `claude_code.cost.usage`, `claude_code.token.usage` and `claude_code.session.count`. `OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL` defaults to 60000 ms. Same doc.

Usage and Cost Admin API: `GET /v1/organizations/usage_report/messages` (buckets 1m, 1h, 1d; filter and group by API key, workspace, model, service tier, context window, data residency, speed) and `GET /v1/organizations/cost_report` (USD as decimal strings in cents; excludes Priority Tier, which you read from the usage endpoint by service tier). Parameters include `bucket_width`, `group_by[]`, `starting_at`, `ending_at`, `service_tiers[]`. Needs an Admin API key (`sk-ant-admin01-...`), an `org:admin` OAuth token or an unscoped key. Workspace keys fail. Not available to individual accounts. Docs: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/usage-cost-api

claude.ai Projects, project knowledge, Research mode, rating-feedback org settings, retention, HIPAA eligibility lists, BAA and zero-data-retention terms, fallback and retirement schedules: confirm in docs. No model ids are listed here. Take them from `claude-api`.

**Structured outputs are generally available.** JSON output goes in `output_config.format` with type `json_schema`. Decoding is constrained, so output is valid and schema-conformant. Strict tool use (`strict: true`) is the sibling feature, and the two can be combined. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs

**Schema limits:** objects need `additionalProperties: false`. Recursive schemas, numeric and string-length constraints, external `$ref`, and `minItems` beyond 0 or 1 are unsupported. Move those checks into your validator. Same page.

**Failure cases:** a `stop_reason` of `refusal`, or truncation at max tokens, can return output that does not match the schema. Structured outputs are incompatible with citations (HTTP 400) and with message prefilling. Same page.
**SDK helpers:** `client.messages.parse` with `output_format` (Pydantic), and `zodOutputFormat()` (Zod). Same page.
**Deprecated:** the old `output_format` request parameter and the `structured-outputs-2025-11-13` beta header. Use `output_config.format`; no header is needed. Same page.

**Models:** current lineup is `claude-fable-5-1`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`. All list 1M context, 128K max output and adaptive thinking. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview

**Effort:** set with `output_config.effort`. Levels named: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` (confirm per-model availability in docs). Thinking is adaptive; manual `budget_tokens` is not accepted on later models. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort

**Sampling parameters:** `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` were removed in API version `2026-10-21` and return 400 even at the default. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations
**Deprecation:** the Sonnet 4.5 snapshot retires 2026-11-30; the replacement named is `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Same deprecations page.
`tool_choice` modes, the Message Batches API and the Claude Code JSON-schema flag are not in the checked set: confirm in docs.
Citations are GA. Set `citations: {enabled: true}` on document blocks, on all or none in a request. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/citations
Location types: `char_location` (plain text), `page_location` (PDF), `content_block_location` (custom content). Same URL as above.
`cited_text` does not count toward output tokens. Same URL as above.
Only text citations are supported. Citations are incompatible with structured outputs (400). Same URL as above.
Source documents can be cached, not citation blocks. Same URL as above.
API version `2026-10-21` rejects a non-empty `citations` array on text blocks in user messages (400); `enabled` on documents and search results is still accepted. Same URL as above.

`search_result` block: required `source` (a URL or any stable id), `title`, `content` (array of text blocks); optional `citations` with `enabled`. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/search-results
It can come from a tool result or sit at the top level of user content; Claude cites it with `search_result_location`. Same URL as above.
No beta header; supported on all active models; the citations setting must match across results in a request. Same URL as above.

API features, model tiers and model ids: confirm in docs, or use `claude-api`. Do not copy ids from this skill, from older designs or from exam material.

A custom tool is `name`, `description`, `input_schema`; `strict: true` guarantees schema-valid inputs. Calls arrive as `tool_use` blocks and you reply with `tool_result` carrying the matching `tool_use_id`. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview

`tool_choice` values listed: `auto` (default), `any`, `tool`, `none`. `auto` accepts `disable_parallel_tool_use: true`. Source: same page. Exact semantics of `any` and `tool`, and their interaction with thinking: confirm in docs.
Tool definitions count as input tokens, plus a per-model tool-use system prompt overhead. Same page.

`stop_reason` values: `end_turn`, `max_tokens`, `stop_sequence`, `tool_use`, `pause_turn`, `refusal`, `model_context_window_exceeded`. Loop on `tool_use`. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons

Tool search: `tool_search_tool_regex_20251119` and `tool_search_tool_bm25_20251119`. Mark hidden tools `defer_loading: true`; at least one tool must stay non-deferred or the request returns 400. Results are `tool_reference` blocks. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/tool-search-tool
The error flag on a tool result (commonly `is_error`): confirm in docs. JSON-encoding of results: confirm in docs.

`.mcp.json` uses the key `mcpServers`. Entry fields: `type` (`http`, `stdio`, `sse`, `ws`), `url`, `headers`, `command`, `args`, `env`, `timeout`, `oauth`, `headersHelper`. No `type` means stdio; `url` without `type` is rejected. `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` expand in `command`, `args`, `env`, `url` and `headers`. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp

Scopes: local (default), project (`.mcp.json`, needs approval), user. Precedence: local, project, user, plugin, claude.ai connectors; no field merging. Set with `claude mcp add --scope` and `--transport`. Same page.
`sse` is deprecated in favour of `http`. Auth routes: `--header`, OAuth via `/mcp` or `claude mcp login`, `headersHelper`. Tool names follow `mcp__<server>__<tool>`. Same page.

MCP connector in the Messages API: beta header `mcp-client-2025-11-20`; config is `mcp_servers` plus an `mcp_toolset` entry in `tools`. Remote HTTP servers only; no local stdio. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-connector
